page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, requiring users to attach external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for accelerated graphics or hardware-dependent machine learning workloads. For networking, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps, supporting standard inter-instance and external communication requirements.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance as a stable resource for workloads requiring predictable compute performance without the premium of specialized memory or storage hardware. It is suited for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, enterprise applications, and medium-sized databases that rely on network-attached storage.
